In essence, higher classification schemes represent expert opinion based on available evidence. Several classification systems have been proposed for nematodes. New opinions on the relationships among taxa are emerging from molecular data. At the present time, we will use for Nemaplex a widely accepted scheme based on nematode morphological and anatomical characters.
